svg.title: S3.3 · Same cluster, same name, "never heard of it": the setup
svg.desc: The cast of scenario 12: Pod showdown (Cats vs Dogs, votes need Redis); Service redis (stable name); Pod redis (the shared, database). Your mission: Both are running. Why can the app not find Redis?
